description: Return one of your organization's policy sets to PRIVATE. Inverse of request_policy_set_approval: removes an approved set from the shared catalog other organizations browse, or withdraws a publication request that is still awaiting review. The set stays fully usable inside your own organization. Campaigns in other organizations that already reference the set keep their binding — going private blocks new attachments rather than breaking existing ones. Safe to call on a set that is already private.
name: unpublish_policy_set
title: Unpublish Policy Set
